description: Calibration of C_TS and Omega_J (noise ceiling, random-bias reference, positive controls) and reweighting cost of each bias. All values are exact or sampled results on the analytic network models; none are MD measurements.

part1_noise_ceiling.description: two-sample sampling noise of C_TS and Omega_J; model-level (network) paths

part1b_biased_own_noise.description: biased-vs-biased two-sample noise and two-band separation test

part2_random_biases.description: random biases at matched budget; exact network-model metrics

kinds.grf_long: Gaussian random field, squared-exponential covariance exp(-r^2/(2 l^2)), l = one well spacing, rescaled to max|b| = U
kinds.grf_short: same, l = one third of a well spacing

part3_positive_controls.description: positive controls; exact network-model metrics and sampled overlaps

part4_ess.definition: ESS/N = 1/sum_i pib_i w_i^2 with w = pi0/pib (Kish, independent samples)

part5_random_routes.description: routes that ignore the landscape, compared with the true unbiased current and last-crossing law; network-model results
